title: OIDCClientRepresentation
description:
Represents an OIDC client representation for dynamic client registration in Keycloak.

This class is based on the Keycloak OIDCClientRepresentation Java class structure
from Keycloak version 26.0.8 documentation:
https://www.keycloak.org/docs-api/26.0.8/javadocs/org/keycloak/representations/oidc/OIDCClientRepresentation.html

Note: This implementation is compatible with Keycloak v26.0.6 and is used for
POST requests to /realms/{realm}/clients-registrations/openid-connect endpoint.

Reference: OpenID Connect Dynamic Client Registration 1.0 specification.

redirect_uris.description:
Gets or sets the array of redirection URI values used by the Client.
One of these registered redirection URI values MUST exactly match the redirect_uri parameter
value used in each Authorization Request.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description:
Gets or sets the requested Client authentication method for the Token Endpoint.
Values: "none", "client_secret_post", "client_secret_basic", "client_secret_jwt", "private_key_jwt".

token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg.description: Gets or sets the requested Client authentication signing algorithm for the Token Endpoint.

grant_types.description:
Gets or sets the array of OAuth 2.0 grant type strings that the Client is declaring that it will restrict itself to using.
Values: "authorization_code", "implicit", "password", "client_credentials", "refresh_token", "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer", "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:saml2-bearer".

response_types.description:
Gets or sets the array of the OAuth 2.0 response_type values that the Client is declaring that it will restrict itself to using.
Values: "code", "token", "id_token".

application_type.description:
Gets or sets the kind of the application. The default, if omitted, is "web".
Values: "web", "native".

client_id.description: Gets or sets the client identifier string. If omitted, the authorization server MUST generate a unique Client Identifier.

client_secret.description: Gets or sets the client secret string. If omitted, the authorization server MAY issue a Client Secret or MAY leave it blank.

client_name.description: Gets or sets the human-readable string name of the Client to be presented to the End-User.

client_uri.description: Gets or sets the URL of the home page of the Client.

logo_uri.description: Gets or sets the URL that references a logo for the Client application.

scope.description: Gets or sets the string containing a space-separated list of scope values that the client can use when requesting access tokens.

contacts.description: Gets or sets the array of strings representing ways to contact people responsible for this Client, typically email addresses.

tos_uri.description: Gets or sets the URL that the Relying Party Client provides to the End-User to read about the how the profile data will be used.

policy_uri.description: Gets or sets the URL that the Relying Party Client provides to the End-User to read about the Relying Party's terms of service.

jwks_uri.description: Gets or sets the URL for the Client's JSON Web Key Set document.

jwks.description: Gets or sets the Client's JSON Web Key Set document, passed by value.

sector_identifier_uri.description: Gets or sets the URL using the https scheme to be used in calculating Pseudonymous Identifiers by the OP.

subject_type.description:
Gets or sets the subject identifier type requested for responses to this Client.
Values: "public", "pairwise".

id_token_signed_response_alg.description: Gets or sets the JWS alg algorithm required for signing the ID Token issued to this Client.

id_token_encrypted_response_alg.description: Gets or sets the JWE alg algorithm required for encrypting the ID Token issued to this Client.

id_token_encrypted_response_enc.description: Gets or sets the JWE enc algorithm required for encrypting the ID Token issued to this Client.

userinfo_signed_response_alg.description: Gets or sets the JWS alg algorithm required for signing UserInfo Responses.

userinfo_encrypted_response_alg.description: Gets or sets the JWE alg algorithm required for encrypting UserInfo Responses.

userinfo_encrypted_response_enc.description: Gets or sets the JWE enc algorithm required for encrypting UserInfo Responses.

request_object_signing_alg.description: Gets or sets the JWS alg algorithm that MUST be used for signing Request Objects sent to the OP.

request_object_encryption_alg.description: Gets or sets the JWE alg algorithm the RP is declaring that it may use for encrypting Request Objects sent to the OP.

request_object_encryption_enc.description: Gets or sets the JWE enc algorithm the RP is declaring that it may use for encrypting Request Objects sent to the OP.

default_max_age.description: Gets or sets the Default Maximum Authentication Age. Specifies that the End-User MUST be actively authenticated if the End-User was authenticated longer ago than the specified number of seconds.

require_auth_time.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the auth_time Claim in the ID Token is REQUIRED.

default_acr_values.description: Gets or sets the default requested Authentication Context Class Reference values.

initiate_login_uri.description: Gets or sets the URI using the https scheme that a third party can use to initiate a login by the RP.

request_uris.description: Gets or sets the array of request_uri values that are pre-registered by the RP for use at the OP.

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: Gets or sets the array of URLs supplied by the RP to which it MAY request that the End-User's User Agent be redirected using the post_logout_redirect_uri parameter after a logout has been performed.

software_id.description: Gets or sets a unique identifier string assigned by the client developer or software publisher.

software_version.description: Gets or sets a version identifier string for the client software identified by "software_id".

client_id_issued_at.description: Gets or sets the time at which the client_id was issued. Represented as seconds from 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z as measured in UTC.

client_secret_expires_at.description: Gets or sets the time at which the client_secret will expire or 0 if it will not expire. Represented as seconds from 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z as measured in UTC.

registration_client_uri.description: Gets or sets the location of the Client Configuration Endpoint where the Registration Access Token can be used to perform subsequent operations upon the Client registration.

registration_access_token.description: Gets or sets the Registration Access Token that can be used at the Client Configuration Endpoint to perform subsequent operations upon the Client registration.

tls_client_certificate_bound_access_toke.description: Gets or sets a value indicating the client's intention to use mutual TLS client certificate bound access tokens.

dpop_bound_access_tokens.description: Gets or sets a value indicating the client's intention to use DPoP proof-of-possession for access tokens.

backchannel_logout_uri.description: Gets or sets the RP URL that will cause the RP to log the user out when sent a Logout Token by the OP.

backchannel_logout_session_required.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the RP requires that a sid (session ID) Claim be included in the Logout Token.

backchannel_logout_revoke_offline_tokens.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the RP wants to have refresh tokens and offline access revoked when the user logs out at the OP.

tls_client_auth_subject_dn.description: Gets or sets the Subject Distinguished Name of the certificate, which the OAuth client will use in mutual TLS authentication.

backchannel_token_delivery_mode.description: Gets or sets the backchannel token delivery mode. Values: "poll", "ping".

backchannel_client_notification_endpoint.description: Gets or sets the backchannel client notification endpoint URL.

backchannel_authentication_request_signi.description: Gets or sets the JWS algorithm for signing backchannel authentication requests.

authorization_signed_response_alg.description: Gets or sets the JWS algorithm for signing authorization responses.

authorization_encrypted_response_alg.description: Gets or sets the JWE algorithm for encrypting authorization responses.

authorization_encrypted_response_enc.description: Gets or sets the JWE encryption algorithm for authorization responses.

require_pushed_authorization_requests.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the client requires the use of pushed authorization requests.

frontchannel_logout_uri.description: Gets or sets the RP URL that will cause the RP to log the user out when called by the OP.

frontchannel_logout_session_required.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the RP requires that iss (issuer) and sid (session ID) query parameters are included to identify the RP session with the OP when the frontchannel_logout_uri is used.
